full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the designation of corporations subject to special provisions concerning liquidation under Article 80 of the State Property Act and Article 79 of the Enforcement Decree thereof. <Amended on July 31, 2009.>
